html:
D123　关单申请与独立审批

第 18 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D122-限定用途的短期凭据。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

实现关单申请和独立审批两个 HTTP 入口。申请里保存工单、租户、版本、说明、发起人和期限。组长能查看原样申请并批准，同一个人不能同时提交和批准。

申请人向 POST /api/agent/runs/:id/close-requests 提交 requestKey、version 和 comment，拿到申请编号后交给复核人。复核人访问 GET /api/agent/close-requests/:id 核对工单、版本、说明和期限，再向同路径下的 /approve 提交空对象。示例通过 API 完成人工交接。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/prisma/migrations/20261119040000_close_approvals/migration.sql
★ apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.controller.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts
★ apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts
★ apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma
★ apps/server/prisma/seed.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/agent.module.ts
★ packages/shared/src/permissions.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 10 分钟，知识点 35 分钟，动手 55 分钟，自检与提交 20 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D122　为什么凭据不写进模型上下文？

核对答案

持有执行能力的对象只由可信执行器保存，模型只看到业务材料。

D120　哪个策略结果表示还需人工判断？

核对答案

具备工单流转权限的账号在关单场景得到 approval。

D116　如何把工具审计与一次运行关联？

核对答案

使用 runId、操作者、工具和参数摘要关联审计记录。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 冻结操作参数，给重复请求确定结果

用户可能双击，也可能在网络超时后重试。按运行和请求键建立唯一约束，已存在时比较版本与说明。相同参数返回原记录，改动参数则要求新申请。审批页面按申请编号读取这份快照。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts -t "相同业务键重试返回同一份审批快照"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts，第四节含完整导入与夹具。

  it('相同业务键重试返回同一份审批快照', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const first = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    expect(first.state).toBe('pending');
    expect((await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id).toBe(first.id);
    await api.post(flow.url).set('authorization', flow.owner).send({ ...flow.terms, comment: '另一项说明' }).expect(409);
    const url = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + first.id;
    expect((await api.get(url).set('authorization', login('carol')).expect(200)).body.data.comment).toBe(flow.terms.comment);
    expect((await api.post(url + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201)).body.data.state).toBe('approved');
  });

推导题　为什么重新提交相同键但不同说明要返回冲突？

答案

同一键对应的是同一项业务意图。替换说明会改变审批人要复核的内容；返回冲突让前端保留原记录并让用户确认新申请。

1.2 把独立复核写成可执行条件

申请人需要工单流转权限；审批人还需要专门的 ticket:approve-close 权限，并且要能看到该工单。当前账号与申请人不同，工单版本匹配且仍已解决，才能把有效申请从 pending 改为 approved。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts -t "只读员工不能提单且组长不能自审"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts，第四节含完整导入与夹具。

  it('只读员工不能提单且组长不能自审', async () => {
    const reader = await setup('dave'); await reader.submit().expect(403);
    const flow = await setup('carol');
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    await api.post('/api/agent/close-requests/' + row.id + '/approve').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({}).expect(403);
    expect((await db.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } })).state).toBe('pending');
  });

推导题　组长同时具备流转和审批权限，为何会被拒绝自审？

答案

角色决定能否担当某一类工作，职责分离检查这次工作的两位参与者是否相同。数据库约束也拒绝把申请人写作复核人。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　建立申请快照和唯一键

提示一 · 方向

先确定有权参与的用户与要关闭的资源。

提示二 · API

CloseApproval、复合唯一约束、freeze_close_terms。

提示三 · 实现顺序

建表、绑定账号和运行、冻结操作字段；审批状态与审批人使用独立列。

步骤 2　提交并由另一人审阅

提示一 · 方向

让提交和批准各自走一遍实时权限检查。

提示二 · API

submit、review、updateMany、audit.record。

提示三 · 实现顺序

用 bob 提单，carol 读取原始快照并批准；再用 carol 自己发起另一单检验自审拒绝。

三、自检与提交

在已解决工单上重复提交两次相同申请，核对行 ID。分别验证只读账号提交和组长自审的 HTTP 状态码，再核对表中记录仍为 pending。

在验证工程的 apps/server 下运行 pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy 和 pnpm exec prisma generate。回到工作区根目录运行 pnpm run ci，对照文末三轮接口测试结果。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts 把 if (previous.version !== version || previous.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数'); 临时替为 if (previous.version !== version || previous.comment !== comment) throw new BadRequestException('请求键已用于其他参数');，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

Error: expected 409 "Conflict", got 400 "Bad Request"

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts 把 throw new ForbiddenException('需要另一位审批人') 临时替为 throw new ConflictException('需要另一位审批人')，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

Error: expected 403 "Forbidden", got 409 "Conflict"

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

提交批改　提交实际 diff、一次正常输出、一条失败断言和恢复结果。说明哪一步看过提示，并说“D123 提交了”。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

4.1 关单申请与独立审批

apps/server/prisma/migrations/20261119040000_close_approvals/migration.sql

CREATE TABLE close_approvals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  requester_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), request_key uuid NOT NULL,
  tenant_key varchar(64) NOT NULL, ticket_no varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  version integer NOT NULL, comment varchar(500) NOT NULL, reviewer_id uuid REFERENCES users(id),
  state varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(run_id, request_key), CHECK (reviewer_id IS DISTINCT FROM requester_id),
  CHECK ((state='pending' AND reviewer_id IS NULL) OR (state IN ('approved','executed') AND reviewer_id IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE FUNCTION freeze_close_terms() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF (NEW.id,NEW.run_id,NEW.requester_id,NEW.request_key,NEW.tenant_key,NEW.ticket_no,NEW.version,NEW.comment,NEW.expires_at)
    IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id,OLD.run_id,OLD.requester_id,OLD.request_key,OLD.tenant_key,OLD.ticket_no,OLD.version,OLD.comment,OLD.expires_at)
    OR (OLD.reviewer_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.reviewer_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reviewer_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'approval terms are immutable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;
CREATE TRIGGER close_terms BEFORE UPDATE ON close_approvals FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION freeze_close_terms();
INSERT INTO permissions(id,code,description) VALUES(gen_random_uuid(),'ticket:approve-close','复核 Agent 关单申请') ON CONFLICT(code) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO role_permissions(role_id,permission_id) SELECT r.id,p.id FROM roles r,permissions p
 WHERE r.code='leader' AND p.code='ticket:approve-close' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.controller.ts

import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, Param, ParseUUIDPipe, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { CloseApprovalService } from './close-approval.service.js';

@Controller('agent')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class CloseApprovalController {
  constructor(private readonly approvals: CloseApprovalService) {}
  @Post('runs/:id/close-requests')
  submit(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    return this.approvals.submit(user.id, id, input);
  }
  @Get('close-requests/:id')
  inspect(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.approvals.review(user.id, id);
  }
  @Post('close-requests/:id/approve')
  approve(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    if (!z.object({}).strict().safeParse(input ?? {}).success) throw new BadRequestException('只接受申请编号');
    return this.approvals.review(user.id, id, true);
  }
}

apps/server/src/agent/close-approval.service.ts

import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { decideTool } from './agent-permission.js';

const terms = z.object({ requestKey: z.uuid(), version: z.number().int().min(0), comment: z.string().trim().min(1).max(500) }).strict();
export async function authorizedTarget(tx: TransactionClient, actor: string, ticketNo: string, tenantKey: string, review = false) {
  const { user } = await readAccess(tx, actor).catch((error: unknown) => {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') throw new ForbiddenException();
    throw error;
  });
  if (user.tenantKey !== tenantKey) throw new NotFoundException();
  if (decideTool(user.permissions ?? [], 'closure', 'close_ticket') !== 'approval' ||
    (review && !user.permissions?.includes('ticket:approve-close'))) throw new ForbiddenException();
  const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ...agentScope(user), ticketNo }, select: { version: true, status: true } });
  if (!ticket) throw new NotFoundException();
  return { user, ticket };
}

@Injectable()
export class CloseApprovalService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly audit: AuditService) {}

  async submit(actor: string, runId: string, input: unknown) {
    const parsed = terms.safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new BadRequestException('关单申请参数无效');
    const { requestKey, version, comment } = parsed.data;
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const run = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, userId: actor } });
      if (!run) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { user, ticket } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, run.ticketNo, run.tenantKey);
      const data = { runId, requesterId: actor, requestKey, tenantKey: run.tenantKey,
        ticketNo: run.ticketNo, version, comment, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 600_000) };
      const previous = await tx.closeApproval.findUnique({ where: { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } } });
      if (previous) {
        if (previous.version !== version || previous.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数');
        return previous;
      }
      if (ticket.version !== version || ticket.status !== 'resolved') throw new ConflictException('工单状态或版本已变化');
      const inserted = await tx.closeApproval.createMany({ data, skipDuplicates: true });
      const row = await tx.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { runId_requestKey: { runId, requestKey } } });
      if (row.version !== version || row.comment !== comment) throw new ConflictException('请求键已用于其他参数');
      if (inserted.count) await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_requested',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: run.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: row.id, version } });
      return row;
    });
  }

  async review(actor: string, id: string, approve = false) {
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const row = await tx.closeApproval.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      const { user, ticket } = await authorizedTarget(tx, actor, row.ticketNo, row.tenantKey, true);
      if (row.requesterId === actor) throw new ForbiddenException('需要另一位审批人');
      if (!approve) return row;
      if (ticket.version !== row.version || ticket.status !== 'resolved') throw new ConflictException('需要重新申请');
      const change = await tx.closeApproval.updateMany({ where: { id, state: 'pending', expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
        data: { state: 'approved', reviewerId: actor } });
      if (!change.count) throw new ConflictException('申请已过期或已处理');
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: actor, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.close_approved',
        entityType: 'ticket', entityKey: row.ticketNo, after: { approvalId: id, version: row.version } });
      return { ...row, reviewerId: actor, state: 'approved' };
    });
  }
}

apps/server/test/agent-close.e2e-spec.ts

import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from '../src/app.setup.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from './fixtures.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from './auth.js';

describe('关单申请的公开接口', () => {
  let app: INestApplication, db: PrismaService, fixtures: TicketFixtures, api: ReturnType<typeof request>;
  let login: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof tokenIssuer>>;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    app = (await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile()).createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app); await app.init(); db = app.get(PrismaService); api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, 'CLS'); login = await tokenIssuer(app);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { ticketNo: { startsWith: 'CLS' } } });
    await fixtures.cleanup(); await app.close();
  });
  async function setup(username: 'bob' | 'carol' | 'dave' = 'bob') {
    const ticket = await fixtures.create({ status: 'processing', assigneeUsername: 'bob' });
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { status: 'resolved', resolvedAt: new Date() } });
    const owner = login(username);
    const run = await api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', owner)
      .send({ ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, requestKey: randomUUID(), goal: '提交关单复核' }).expect(201);
    const url = '/api/agent/runs/' + run.body.data.id + '/close-requests';
    const record = await db.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ticket.id } });
    const terms = { requestKey: randomUUID(), version: record.version, comment: '已复核恢复记录' };
    const submit = () => api.post(url).set('authorization', owner).send(terms);
    return { ticket, terms, submit, url, owner };
  }
  it('相同业务键重试返回同一份审批快照', async () => {
    const flow = await setup();
    const first = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    expect(first.state).toBe('pending');
    expect((await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data.id).toBe(first.id);
    await api.post(flow.url).set('authorization', flow.owner).send({ ...flow.terms, comment: '另一项说明' }).expect(409);
    const url = '/api/agent/close-requests/' + first.id;
    expect((await api.get(url).set('authorization', login('carol')).expect(200)).body.data.comment).toBe(flow.terms.comment);
    expect((await api.post(url + '/approve').set('authorization', login('carol')).send({}).expect(201)).body.data.state).toBe('approved');
  });
  it('只读员工不能提单且组长不能自审', async () => {
    const reader = await setup('dave'); await reader.submit().expect(403);
    const flow = await setup('carol');
    const row = (await flow.submit().expect(201)).body.data;
    await api.post('/api/agent/close-requests/' + row.id + '/approve').set('authorization', flow.owner).send({}).expect(403);
    expect((await db.closeApproval.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: row.id } })).state).toBe('pending');
  });
});

apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma

// 工单系统数据模型，对应 docs/data-model.md
// 状态、优先级等取值限制和跨字段规则 Prisma schema 表达不了，写在迁移 SQL 的 CHECK 约束里

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model User {
  tenantKey String @default("legacy") @map("tenant_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  id           String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  username     String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  displayName  String   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(64)
  // 密码的 scrypt 哈希，格式见 src/auth/password.ts；为空表示这个账号不能登录（D15）
  passwordHash String?  @map("password_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  // 所属班组（D17）；系统账号、跨班组的管理人员可以没有班组
  groupId      String?  @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  // 手机号（D19）：敏感字段，没有 contact:read 权限的人看到的是脱敏后的 138****0001
  phone        String?  @db.VarChar(20)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  group     Group?     @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  roles     UserRole[]
  auditLogs AuditLog[]

  toolNotes AgentToolNote[]
  reportedTickets Ticket[]      @relation("TicketReporter")
  assignedTickets Ticket[]      @relation("TicketAssignee")
  ticketEvents    TicketEvent[]
  notifications   Notification[]
  aiQuotas        AiQuota[]
  aiConversations AiConversation[]

  @@map("users")
  agentRuns AgentRun[]
}

model Device {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(128)
  type      String   @db.VarChar(32)
  location  String?  @db.VarChar(128)
  // 设备归哪个班组维护；告警自动建的工单归这个班组（D17）
  groupId   String   @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  group   Group    @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  tickets Ticket[]
  alerts  Alert[]

  @@map("devices")
}

model Ticket {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  ticketNo    String    @unique @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(20)
  title       String    @db.VarChar(200)
  description String    @default("")
  category    String    @default("other") @db.VarChar(16)
  creationKey String?   @map("creation_key") @db.Uuid
  creationHash String?  @map("creation_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  status      String    @default("pending") @db.VarChar(16)
  priority    String    @default("P3") @db.VarChar(2)
  deviceId    String?   @map("device_id") @db.Uuid
  reporterId  String    @map("reporter_id") @db.Uuid
  assigneeId  String?   @map("assignee_id") @db.Uuid
  // 工单归属的班组：只有这个班组的人能看、能处理（D17 行级权限）
  groupId     String    @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  version     Int       @default(0)
  slaDueAt    DateTime  @map("sla_due_at") @db.Timestamptz
  resolvedAt  DateTime? @map("resolved_at") @db.Timestamptz
  closedAt    DateTime? @map("closed_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // SLA 超时扫描（D25）发出超时通知的时间；为空表示还没通知过。条件更新它，保证每张工单只通知一次
  slaBreachedAt DateTime? @map("sla_breached_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // 超时满 30 分钟仍待处理时升级一次；和升级事件在同一事务里写入（D32）
  slaEscalatedAt DateTime? @map("sla_escalated_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // @updatedAt 由 Prisma Client 在每次更新时填写，绕过 Prisma 的写入不会刷新它
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  device   Device? @relation(fields: [deviceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  reporter User    @relation("TicketReporter", fields: [reporterId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  assignee User?   @relation("TicketAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  group    Group   @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  toolNotes AgentToolNote[]
  alerts Alert[]
  events TicketEvent[]

  // 工作台列表：按状态筛选、按创建时间倒序；末尾加 id，和排序完全一致，游标分页也能直接用（D5）
  @@index([status, createdAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "tickets_status_created_at_id_idx")
  // 班组的工作台列表：班组是等值条件，放在最前面（D4：等值条件在前、排序列在后）（D17）
  @@index([groupId, status, createdAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "tickets_group_status_created_at_id_idx")
  // 我的工单：按处理人和状态筛选
  @@index([assigneeId, status], map: "tickets_assignee_status_idx")
  @@unique([reporterId, creationKey], map: "tickets_reporter_creation_unique")
  @@map("tickets")
}

model Alert {

model TicketEvent {

// ---------- 角色与权限（D16） ----------
// 权限点的取值见 packages/shared/src/permissions.ts；角色和“角色有哪些权限”是数据，由种子写入

model Role {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  permissions RolePermission[]
  users       UserRole[]

  @@map("roles")
}

model Permission {
  id          String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code        String @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  description String @db.VarChar(200)

  roles RolePermission[]

  @@map("permissions")
}

// 关联表：删除角色或权限时，关联行跟着删（Cascade）。
// 这是对“外键一律 RESTRICT”（D1）的有意例外：关联行不是业务历史，留着没有意义
model RolePermission {
  roleId       String @map("role_id") @db.Uuid
  permissionId String @map("permission_id") @db.Uuid

  role       Role       @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  permission Permission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([roleId, permissionId])
  // 主键以 role_id 开头，按权限查角色要单独的索引
  @@index([permissionId], map: "role_permissions_permission_id_idx")
  @@map("role_permissions")
}

model UserRole {
  userId    String   @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  roleId    String   @map("role_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role Role @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([userId, roleId])
  @@index([roleId], map: "user_roles_role_id_idx")
  @@map("user_roles")
}

// ---------- 操作审计（D18） ----------
// 只追加、不修改、不删除：迁移里用触发器在数据库层拒绝 UPDATE、DELETE、TRUNCATE
model AuditLog {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  occurredAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("occurred_at") @db.Timestamptz
  actorId       String   @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  // 操作时的用户名快照：以后用户改名，审计里仍是当时的名字
  actorUsername String   @map("actor_username") @db.VarChar(64)
  // 做了什么，例如 ticket.transition、ticket.batch_assign
  action        String   @db.VarChar(64)
  entityType    String   @map("entity_type") @db.VarChar(32)
  // 业务上的标识（工单编号、设备编码），不用外键：被审计的数据删了，审计也要留着
  entityKey     String   @map("entity_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  before        Json?
  after         Json?
  // 同一个请求产生的审计、日志用它串起来
  requestId     String?  @map("request_id") @db.VarChar(64)

  actor User @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  // 按工单查审计时间线
  @@index([entityType, entityKey, occurredAt], map: "audit_logs_entity_idx")
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// Outbox（D31）：业务事务里顺手写一行“要发出去的事件”，和业务数据一起提交或一起回滚
// 投递器（OutboxRelay）再把还没投递的行放进队列，放进去以后填上 published_at
model OutboxEvent {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // ticket.assigned、ticket.sla_breached、ticket.sla_escalated
  type        String    @db.VarChar(64)
  payload     Json
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // 放进队列的时间；为空表示还没投递
  publishedAt DateTime? @map("published_at") @db.Timestamptz

  // 投递器每次按创建时间取还没投递的
  @@index([publishedAt, createdAt], map: "outbox_events_unpublished_idx")
  @@map("outbox_events")
}

// 站内通知（D31）：通知 Worker 根据 Outbox 事件生成，D33 推到页面上
model Notification {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // D33：SSE 的持久游标。写入入口先锁用户，再分配序号并提交，避免同一用户提交乱序。
  streamSeq BigInt    @unique @default(autoincrement()) @map("stream_seq")
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  type      String    @db.VarChar(64)
  title     String    @db.VarChar(200)
  ticketNo  String?   @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(20)
  // 来自哪个 Outbox 事件：同一个事件给同一个人只生成一条通知，任务重做多少次都一样（D30 的消费者幂等）
  eventId   String    @map("event_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  readAt    DateTime? @map("read_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  @@unique([eventId, userId], map: "notifications_event_user_unique")
  // 查“我的通知”，按时间倒序
  @@index([userId, createdAt], map: "notifications_user_created_idx")
  @@index([userId, streamSeq], map: "notifications_user_stream_idx")
  @@map("notifications")
}

// 种子数据：给开发和测试一份固定、可重复执行的数据
// 可重复执行：每条记录都按唯一键 upsert，执行多少次结果都一样
import 'dotenv/config';
import { PERMISSIONS, type Permission } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg';
import { hashPassword } from '../src/auth/password.js';
import { PrismaClient } from '../src/generated/prisma/client.js';

const adapter = new PrismaPg({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
const prisma = new PrismaClient({ adapter });

// 固定时间，保证每次生成的数据完全一样，测试结果可以复现
const BASE = new Date('2026-11-14T01:00:00.000Z');
const minutesLater = (minutes: number) =>
  new Date(BASE.getTime() + minutes * 60_000);

async function main() {
  // 0. 班组（D17）：ops-a 在迁移里已经建好（已有的设备和工单归它），这里按 code upsert 保证名称一致
  const groups = [
    { code: 'ops-a', name: '运维一组' },
    { code: 'ops-b', name: '运维二组' },
  ];
  const groupIds = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const group of groups) {
    const saved = await prisma.group.upsert({ where: { code: group.code }, update: { name: group.name }, create: group });
    groupIds.set(group.code, saved.id);
  }
  const groupId = (code: string | null) => (code ? groupIds.get(code)! : null);

  // 1. 用户：按 username 唯一键 upsert
  // role 是每个用户的角色（D16），角色有哪些权限见下面第 1.5 步；group 是所属班组（D17）
  // phone 是虚构的测试号码（D19），不要换成真实的手机号
  const users = [
    { username: 'alice', displayName: '张三', role: 'operator', group: 'ops-a', phone: '13800000001' }, // 值班人员，负责提单和复核
    { username: 'bob', displayName: '李四', role: 'operator', group: 'ops-a', phone: '13800000002' }, // 处理人
    { username: 'carol', displayName: '王五', role: 'leader', group: 'ops-a', phone: '13800000003' }, // 组长
    { username: 'monitor', displayName: '监控系统', role: 'system', group: null, phone: null }, // 告警上报用的系统账号（D11）
    { username: 'dave', displayName: '赵六', role: 'viewer', group: null, phone: '13800000004' }, // 只读：部门经理看报表（D16），能看所有班组（D17）
    { username: 'erin', displayName: '钱七', role: 'operator', group: 'ops-b', phone: '13800000005' }, // 二组的运维人员（D17）
  ];
  // 所有种子用户用同一个密码，来自 .env（D15）。不写默认值：密码不能出现在代码里
  const password = process.env.SEED_USER_PASSWORD;
  if (!password) {
    throw new Error('缺少环境变量 SEED_USER_PASSWORD，请检查 apps/server/.env');
  }
  for (const { role: _role, group, ...user } of users) {
    // 每次执行都重新设置密码：.env 里改了密码，重新执行种子就生效
    const passwordHash = await hashPassword(password);
    await prisma.user.upsert({
      where: { username: user.username },
      update: { displayName: user.displayName, phone: user.phone, passwordHash, groupId: groupId(group) },
      create: { ...user, passwordHash, groupId: groupId(group) },
    });
  }

  // 1.5 角色与权限（D16）
  // 权限点的取值来自 shared（代码里写死）；角色、角色的权限、用户的角色是数据，种子每次执行都同步成下面的样子
  const permissionDescriptions: Record<Permission, string> = {
    'ticket:create': '人工创建工单与申请AI建议',
    'ticket:read': '查看工单和设备告警',
    'ticket:approve-close': '复核 Agent 关单申请',
    'ticket:transition': '接单、解决、退回、关闭、取消工单',
    'ticket:assign': '批量指派、改派工单',
    'device:manage': '删除设备',
    'alert:report': '上报告警',
    'ticket:all-groups': '不受班组限制，可以看、可以处理所有班组的工单',
    'audit:read': '查看操作审计',
    'contact:read': '查看完整的联系方式（手机号）',
    'ticket:comment': '给工单加评论',
  'queue:manage': '查看、重放失败的后台任务',
  };
  for (const code of PERMISSIONS) {
    await prisma.permission.upsert({
      where: { code },
      update: { description: permissionDescriptions[code] },
      create: { code, description: permissionDescriptions[code] },
    });
  }
  const roles: { code: string; name: string; permissions: Permission[] }[] = [
    { code: 'viewer', name: '只读', permissions: ['ticket:read', 'ticket:all-groups', 'audit:read'] },
    { code: 'operator', name: '运维人员', permissions: ['ticket:read', 'ticket:create', 'ticket:transition', 'ticket:comment'] },
    {
      code: 'leader',
      name: '组长',
      permissions: [
        'ticket:read',
        'ticket:transition',
        'ticket:approve-close',
        'ticket:assign',
        'ticket:create',
        'device:manage',
        'audit:read',
        'contact:read',
        'ticket:comment',
        // 组长负责处理失败的后台任务：看原因、修好以后重放（D30）
        'queue:manage',
      ],
    },
    { code: 'system', name: '系统账号', permissions: ['alert:report'] },
  ];
  for (const role of roles) {
    const saved = await prisma.role.upsert({
      where: { code: role.code },
      update: { name: role.name },
      create: { code: role.code, name: role.name },
    });
    const permissions = await prisma.permission.findMany({ where: { code: { in: role.permissions } } });
    // 先删后建：种子里去掉了某个权限，重新执行后数据库里也去掉
    await prisma.rolePermission.deleteMany({ where: { roleId: saved.id } });
    await prisma.rolePermission.createMany({ data: permissions.map((p) => ({ roleId: saved.id, permissionId: p.id })) });
  }
  for (const user of users) {
    const saved = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { username: user.username } });
    const role = await prisma.role.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: user.role } });
    await prisma.userRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: saved.id } });
    await prisma.userRole.create({ data: { userId: saved.id, roleId: role.id } });
  }
  const alice = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { username: 'alice' } });
  const bob = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { username: 'bob' } });

  // 2. 设备：按资产编号 code upsert
  const devices = [
    { code: 'srv-001', name: '订单服务器', type: 'server', location: '杭州机房 A01', group: 'ops-a' },
    { code: 'srv-002', name: '支付服务器', type: 'server', location: '杭州机房 A02', group: 'ops-a' },
    { code: 'sw-core-01', name: '核心交换机', type: 'switch', location: null, group: 'ops-b' },
  ];
  for (const { group, ...device } of devices) {
    await prisma.device.upsert({
      where: { code: device.code },
      update: { name: device.name, type: device.type, location: device.location, groupId: groupId(group)! },
      create: { ...device, groupId: groupId(group)! },
    });
  }
  const srv001 = await prisma.device.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'srv-001' } });

  // 3. 工单：五种状态各一张，按 ticketNo upsert
  // 处理记录只在第一次创建工单时一起写入（update 为空），重复执行不会产生重复记录
  const tickets = [
    {
      ticketNo: 'T20261114-0001', title: '订单服务器 CPU 持续 95%', priority: 'P1',
      status: 'pending', assigneeId: null, resolvedAt: null, closedAt: null,
      events: [{ actorId: alice.id, type: 'created', content: '由告警自动创建' }],
    },
    {
      ticketNo: 'T20261114-0002', title: '支付接口超时率升高', priority: 'P2',
      status: 'processing', assigneeId: bob.id, resolvedAt: null, closedAt: null,
      events: [
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'created', content: '' },
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'assigned', content: '指派给李四' },
        { actorId: bob.id, type: 'status_changed', fromStatus: 'pending', toStatus: 'processing', content: '开始排查' },
      ],
    },
    {
      ticketNo: 'T20261114-0003', title: '磁盘使用率超过 85%', priority: 'P3',
      status: 'resolved', assigneeId: bob.id, resolvedAt: minutesLater(90), closedAt: null,
      events: [
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'created', content: '' },
        { actorId: bob.id, type: 'status_changed', fromStatus: 'processing', toStatus: 'resolved', content: '已清理日志' },
      ],
    },
    {
      ticketNo: 'T20261114-0004', title: '证书即将过期', priority: 'P2',
      status: 'closed', assigneeId: bob.id, resolvedAt: minutesLater(60), closedAt: minutesLater(120),
      events: [
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'created', content: '' },
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'status_changed', fromStatus: 'resolved', toStatus: 'closed', content: '复核通过' },
      ],
    },
    {
      ticketNo: 'T20261114-0005', title: '监控探针误报', priority: 'P4',
      status: 'cancelled', assigneeId: null, resolvedAt: null, closedAt: minutesLater(10),
      events: [
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'created', content: '' },
        { actorId: alice.id, type: 'status_changed', fromStatus: 'pending', toStatus: 'cancelled', content: '探针配置错误，属于误报' },
      ],
    },
  ];
  for (const { events, ...ticket } of tickets) {
    await prisma.ticket.upsert({
      where: { ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo },
      update: {},
      create: {
        ...ticket,
        deviceId: srv001.id,
        groupId: srv001.groupId, // 工单归设备所在的班组（D17）
        reporterId: alice.id,
        slaDueAt: minutesLater(240),
        createdAt: BASE,
        // 处理记录按顺序每条晚 1 分钟，时间固定，排序也稳定
        events: { create: events.map((event, i) => ({ ...event, createdAt: minutesLater(i) })) },
      },
    });
  }

  // 4. 告警：按 (source, dedupKey) 组合唯一键 upsert，第一条合并到 0001 号工单
  const ticket0001 = await prisma.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { ticketNo: 'T20261114-0001' } });
  await prisma.alert.upsert({
    where: { source_dedupKey: { source: 'prometheus', dedupKey: 'srv-001:cpu_high' } },
    update: {},
    create: {
      deviceId: srv001.id, ticketId: ticket0001.id, source: 'prometheus',
      dedupKey: 'srv-001:cpu_high', severity: 'critical', message: 'CPU 使用率 > 90% 持续 5 分钟',
      occurredAt: BASE,
    },
  });

  const counts = {
    users: await prisma.user.count(),
    devices: await prisma.device.count(),
    tickets: await prisma.ticket.count(),
    alerts: await prisma.alert.count(),
    ticketEvents: await prisma.ticketEvent.count(),
  };
  console.log('种子数据完成：', counts);
}

try {
  await main();
} finally {
  // 无论成功失败都断开连接，否则进程不会退出
  await prisma.$disconnect();
}

import { z } from 'zod';

// 权限点（D16）：后端用它声明每个接口需要什么权限，前端用它决定显示哪些按钮（D20）
// 权限点是代码里写死的，“哪个角色有哪些权限点”是数据库里的数据，可以不改代码就调整
export const PERMISSIONS = [
  'ticket:create', // 人工创建工单与申请AI分诊建议
  'ticket:read', // 查看工单、设备告警
  'ticket:approve-close', // 独立复核 Agent 关单申请
  'ticket:transition', // 接单、解决、退回、关闭、取消
  'ticket:assign', // 批量指派、改派
  'device:manage', // 删除设备
  'alert:report', // 上报告警（系统账号）
  'ticket:all-groups', // 不受班组限制，能看、能处理所有班组的工单（D17）
  'audit:read', // 查看操作审计（D18）
  'contact:read', // 查看完整的手机号等联系方式，没有时看到的是脱敏后的值（D19）
  'ticket:comment', // 给工单加评论（D21 变式练习）
  'queue:manage', // 查看、重放失败的后台任务（D30）
] as const;
export const permissionSchema = z.enum(PERMISSIONS);
export type Permission = z.infer<typeof permissionSchema>;

// GET /api/auth/me 的 data（D16 加 permissions，D19 加 phone）。前端用 permissions 决定显示哪些按钮（D20）
export const meResponseSchema = z.object({
  username: z.string(),
  displayName: z.string(),
  phone: z.string().nullable(),
  permissions: z.array(permissionSchema),
});
export type MeResponse = z.infer<typeof meResponseSchema>;
